# the modifiers of the regimen in force; none without the hold (DA_AT_monthly)
DA_AT_sync = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_defensive_shock NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_The_Dwarven_Workshop_training_defensive_shock } }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_The_Dwarven_Workshop_training_defensive_shock duration = -1 }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_The_Dwarven_Workshop_training_defensive_shock_artificer duration = -1 }
		add_country_modifier = { name = DA_The_Dwarven_Workshop_training_force_limit_modifier_low duration = -1 }

		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_defensive_fire NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_The_Dwarven_Workshop_training_defensive_fire } }

DA_AT_clear_regimen = {
	clr_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_defensive_shock
	clr_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_defensive_fire
	clr_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_offensive_shock
	clr_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_offensive_fire
	clr_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_all_rounder_low
	clr_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_defensive
	clr_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_offensive
	clr_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_all_rounder_mid
	clr_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_all_rounder_high
	clr_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_amldavhad
}

# a regimen is chosen: the first one the yards ever teach takes hold at once, a change needs 12 months
DA_AT_begin_defensive_shock = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_AT_ever_drilled } }
		set_country_flag = DA_AT_ever_drilled
		DA_AT_clear_regimen = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_defensive_shock
		DA_AT_remove_mods = yes
		DA_AT_sync = yes
	}
	else = {
		set_country_flag = DA_AT_next_defensive_shock
		set_variable = { which = DA_AT_retrain_months value = 12 }
	}
}

# the new regimen has taken hold
DA_AT_finish_retraining = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_AT_next_defensive_shock }
		clr_country_flag = DA_AT_next_defensive_shock
		DA_AT_clear_regimen = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_defensive_shock
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_AT_next_defensive_fire }
		clr_country_flag = DA_AT_next_defensive_fire
		DA_AT_clear_regimen = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_defensive_fire
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_AT_next_offensive_shock }
		clr_country_flag = DA_AT_next_offensive_shock
		DA_AT_clear_regimen = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_offensive_shock
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_AT_next_offensive_fire }
		clr_country_flag = DA_AT_next_offensive_fire
		DA_AT_clear_regimen = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_offensive_fire
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_AT_next_all_rounder_low }
		clr_country_flag = DA_AT_next_all_rounder_low
		DA_AT_clear_regimen = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_all_rounder_low
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_AT_next_defensive }
		clr_country_flag = DA_AT_next_defensive
		DA_AT_clear_regimen = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_defensive
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_AT_next_offensive }
		clr_country_flag = DA_AT_next_offensive
		DA_AT_clear_regimen = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_offensive
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_AT_next_all_rounder_mid }
		clr_country_flag = DA_AT_next_all_rounder_mid
		DA_AT_clear_regimen = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_all_rounder_mid
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_AT_next_all_rounder_high }
		clr_country_flag = DA_AT_next_all_rounder_high
		DA_AT_clear_regimen = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_all_rounder_high
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_AT_next_amldavhad }
		clr_country_flag = DA_AT_next_amldavhad
		DA_AT_clear_regimen = yes
		set_country_flag = DA_AT_regimen_amldavhad
	}
	set_variable = { which = DA_AT_retrain_months value = 0 }
	DA_AT_remove_mods = yes
	DA_AT_sync = yes
	country_event = { id = DA_Mithradum_event.20 }
}

# the yards go back to the common drill; a change that was under way is given up
DA_AT_stand_down = {
	DA_AT_clear_regimen = yes
	clr_country_flag = DA_AT_next_defensive_shock
	clr_country_flag = DA_AT_next_defensive_fire
	clr_country_flag = DA_AT_next_offensive_shock
	clr_country_flag = DA_AT_next_offensive_fire
	clr_country_flag = DA_AT_next_all_rounder_low
	clr_country_flag = DA_AT_next_defensive
	clr_country_flag = DA_AT_next_offensive
	clr_country_flag = DA_AT_next_all_rounder_mid
	clr_country_flag = DA_AT_next_all_rounder_high
	clr_country_flag = DA_AT_next_amldavhad
	set_variable = { which = DA_AT_retrain_months value = 0 }
	DA_AT_remove_mods = yes
}

# a captain from the Roll of the Shields. Called from the hidden event DA_Mithradum_event.30 only: a random_list called from a button
# gives the same result every time. Pips follow army tradition, as DA_create_High_tier_balanced_general gives them.
DA_AT_define_captain = {
	set_saved_name = { key = root_name_male type = advisor scope = ROOT }
	set_saved_name = { key = root_name_female type = advisor female = yes scope = ROOT }
	if = {
		limit = { has_country_flag = DA_AT_first_captain_due }
		clr_country_flag = DA_AT_first_captain_due
		if = {
			limit = { army_tradition = 0 NOT = { army_tradition = 20 } }
			random_list = {
				50 = { define_general = { fire = 4 shock = 5 manuever = 3 siege = 2 trait = Mithril_Class_Rune_Mage_general_personality name = root_name_male } }
				50 = { define_general = { fire = 4 shock = 5 manuever = 3 siege = 2 trait = Mithril_Class_Rune_Mage_general_personality female = yes name = root_name_female } }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { army_tradition = 20 NOT = { army_tradition = 40 } }
			random_list = {
				50 = { define_general = { fire = 5 shock = 6 manuever = 4 siege = 3 trait = Mithril_Class_Rune_Mage_general_personality name = root_name_male } }
				50 = { define_general = { fire = 5 shock = 6 manuever = 4 siege = 3 trait = Mithril_Class_Rune_Mage_general_personality female = yes name = root_name_female } }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { army_tradition = 40 NOT = { army_tradition = 60 } }
			random_list = {
				50 = { define_general = { fire = 6 shock = 7 manuever = 5 siege = 4 trait = Mithril_Class_Rune_Mage_general_personality name = root_name_male } }
				50 = { define_general = { fire = 6 shock = 7 manuever = 5 siege = 4 trait = Mithril_Class_Rune_Mage_general_personality female = yes name = root_name_female } }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { army_tradition = 60 NOT = { army_tradition = 80 } }
			random_list = {
				50 = { define_general = { fire = 7 shock = 7 manuever = 5 siege = 5 trait = Mithril_Class_Rune_Mage_general_personality name = root_name_male } }
				50 = { define_general = { fire = 7 shock = 7 manuever = 5 siege = 5 trait = Mithril_Class_Rune_Mage_general_personality female = yes name = root_name_female } }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { army_tradition = 80 }
			random_list = {
				50 = { define_general = { fire = 8 shock = 8 manuever = 5 siege = 5 trait = Mithril_Class_Rune_Mage_general_personality name = root_name_male } }
				50 = { define_general = { fire = 8 shock = 8 manuever = 5 siege = 5 trait = Mithril_Class_Rune_Mage_general_personality female = yes name = root_name_female } }
			}
		}
	}
	else = {
		if = {
			limit = { army_tradition = 0 NOT = { army_tradition = 20 } }
			random_list = {
				50 = { define_general = { fire = 3 shock = 4 manuever = 3 siege = 2 trait = Mithril_Class_Rune_Mage_general_personality name = root_name_male } }
				50 = { define_general = { fire = 3 shock = 4 manuever = 3 siege = 2 trait = Mithril_Class_Rune_Mage_general_personality female = yes name = root_name_female } }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { army_tradition = 20 NOT = { army_tradition = 40 } }
			random_list = {
				50 = { define_general = { fire = 4 shock = 5 manuever = 4 siege = 3 trait = Mithril_Class_Rune_Mage_general_personality name = root_name_male } }
				50 = { define_general = { fire = 4 shock = 5 manuever = 4 siege = 3 trait = Mithril_Class_Rune_Mage_general_personality female = yes name = root_name_female } }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { army_tradition = 40 NOT = { army_tradition = 60 } }
			random_list = {
				50 = { define_general = { fire = 5 shock = 6 manuever = 5 siege = 4 trait = Mithril_Class_Rune_Mage_general_personality name = root_name_male } }
				50 = { define_general = { fire = 5 shock = 6 manuever = 5 siege = 4 trait = Mithril_Class_Rune_Mage_general_personality female = yes name = root_name_female } }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { army_tradition = 60 NOT = { army_tradition = 80 } }
			random_list = {
				50 = { define_general = { fire = 6 shock = 6 manuever = 5 siege = 5 trait = Mithril_Class_Rune_Mage_general_personality name = root_name_male } }
				50 = { define_general = { fire = 6 shock = 6 manuever = 5 siege = 5 trait = Mithril_Class_Rune_Mage_general_personality female = yes name = root_name_female } }
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { army_tradition = 80 }
			random_list = {
				50 = { define_general = { fire = 7 shock = 7 manuever = 5 siege = 5 trait = Mithril_Class_Rune_Mage_general_personality name = root_name_male } }
				50 = { define_general = { fire = 7 shock = 7 manuever = 5 siege = 5 trait = Mithril_Class_Rune_Mage_general_personality female = yes name = root_name_female } }
			}
		}
	}
	clear_saved_name = root_name_male
	clear_saved_name = root_name_female
}

# every month, for the owner of Mithradhum and for a country that still carries modifiers of the yards
DA_AT_monthly = {
	if = {
		limit = { DA_AT_facility_found = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { DA_AT_mods_in_step = yes } }
			DA_AT_remove_mods = yes
			DA_AT_sync = yes
		}
		if = {
			limit = { DA_AT_facility_at_tier_1 = yes }
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_AT_yards_open } }    # the first month of tier I: the first class enters the yards
				set_country_flag = DA_AT_yards_open
				set_variable = { which = DA_AT_class_months value = 60 }
			}
			else = {
				if = {
					limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_AT_class_months value = 1 } }
					subtract_variable = { which = DA_AT_class_months value = 1 }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_AT_class_months value = 1 } } }
					set_variable = { which = DA_AT_class_months value = 60 }
					country_event = { id = DA_Mithradum_event.21 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { DA_AT_any_next = yes }
				subtract_variable = { which = DA_AT_retrain_months value = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_AT_retrain_months value = 1 } } }
					DA_AT_finish_retraining = yes
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				DA_AT_facility_at_tier_3 = yes
				4236 = { has_province_flag = DA_Mithradhum_exp3 }
				NOT = { DA_AT_ruled = yes }
				OR = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_AT_ruling_asked } had_country_flag = { flag = DA_AT_ruling_asked days = 60 } }    # asked once; again if the event could not fire
			}
			set_country_flag = DA_AT_ruling_asked
			country_event = { id = DA_Mithradum_event.5 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { DA_AT_any_regimen_mod = yes }    # the hold is lost: the regimen lapses; a change under way and the class wait
		DA_AT_remove_mods = yes
	}
}
